## Summary
Press release announcing the official Enfocus AppStore release of "Infigo Connect," a turnkey Switch app that ingests Infigo orders into Enfocus Switch workflows. Important for our shop because the Infigo → Switch path is a documented pipeline option alongside the ConnectID/PrintIQ path.

## Key takeaways
- **App lives on the Enfocus AppStore**, not on Infigo's side — installs into a customer's Switch instance.
- **Two intake methods supported:** webhooks (push from Infigo) and polling (Switch pulls). Lets the customer pick based on firewall/network reality.
- **What gets pulled into Switch per order:** artwork file + job order specifications (so Switch flows can branch on product type, quantity, finishing, etc., without re-keying from a CSR system).
- **Switch's job (Davy Verstaen, Enfocus AppStore Manager):** auto-prepare production files for any printing technology — offset, digital sheetfed, wide format — using Switch's existing automation capabilities. Files go production-ready to the press.
- **Bi-directional status flow:** Switch can post status updates back to Infigo at production, shipping, invoicing stages. Closes the loop on visibility/traceability without manual status updates.
- **Strategic implication:** Customers who already own Switch (very common for prepress-heavy shops) get an Infigo bridge without writing custom Connect Flow modules. Competing path to ConnectID for the artwork-handoff use case, though ConnectID has broader job-flow scope.
- **Named Infigo voice:** Chris Minn, Head of Global Marketing at Infigo.

## Code / config snippets
None published — implementation is a Switch app install + configuration in Switch's UI.
